reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown read Jesus's reply as ranking spiritual blessedness above Mary's motherhood, not stripping the honor Gabriel and Elisabeth gave her.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible reads Jesus's answer as a flat denial that his mother held any special blessing, cutting against Gabriel's and Elisabeth's greeting.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.verseText: Having come in, the angel said to her, \"Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!\"

sides.snippet: blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.
sides.verseText: But he said, \"On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.\"
